definition: a barrier made of a horizontal bar on supports
description: Phone footage from inside a car stuck in morning traffic. A schoolboy in a white shirt and dark tie sits by the open window with cars packed around him and leans out to look along the jammed lanes as scooters squeeze past. He then walks up the steps of a pedestrian footbridge and takes hold of its metal railing with both hands, standing at the horizontal bar between its upright supports and looking down at hundreds of cars filling every lane of the hazy motorway below.

es.answer: Se está agarrando a la barra de metal.
